Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner broadened the meaning of “give off their own light” to include infrared thermal emission and rare phenomena (auroras, fluorescence), instead of the standard educational context referring to steady visible light emission (luminous objects). This misinterpretation contradicted the gathered sources indicating that planets, moons, and comets are seen primarily by reflected sunlight, leading to the incorrect selection of D instead of the conventional correct answer A (only the Sun).
